scenes.text: What is one-half of 4 counters? Let us think carefully. Share 4 into 2 equal groups to get 2 in each. The answer is 2. Great work!
What is one-third of 6 counters? Let us think carefully. Share 6 into 3 equal groups to get 2 in each. The answer is 2. Great work!
What is one-quarter of 8 counters? Let us think carefully. Share 8 into 4 equal groups to get 2 in each. The answer is 2. Great work!
What is one-fifth of 10 counters? Let us think carefully. Share 10 into 5 equal groups to get 2 in each. The answer is 2. Great work!
